{{dablink|For the husband of [[Jac al'Seen]], see [[Elisa al'Seen]]. For others with the same surname, see [[al'Vere]].}}

'''Elisa al'Vere''' is the third eldest sister of [[Egwene]]. She is the middle child of the al'Vere family, younger than [[Berowyn al'Vere|Berowyn]] and [[Alene al'Vere|Alene]], older than [[Loise al'Vere|Loise]] and [[Egwene]]. 

==Abilities==
Elisa "might have been able to learn to channel".{{ref|{{twotc}}, Elisa al'Vere}} 

==History==
She was born in the year {{ne|973}} and allowed to braid her hair in {{ne|992}}.

Elisa was given to offering advice and homilies.

==Activities==
Elisa is one of many people folding fleece at the annual sheep-shearing in [[Emond's Field]].{{ref/book|1|r}}

After Perrin left the Two Rivers, Elisa married a maker of musical instruments from Tarabon, who was twenty years older than her, and she took to wearing Taraboner clothes when she wasn't wearing Domani.

==Name Origin==
Elisa could either be adapted from the common real-world name Elisabeth or '''Ellisande''', referring to Queen [[Eldrene ay Ellan ay Carlan]], the last Queen of [[Manetheren]].
